p1: True Developments is a Monterrey-based real estate developer.
p2: Its partners bring a combined 18 years of experience developing warehouses, industrial buildings and industrial parks in Mexico. We build to hold, not just to sell.
p3:
We design, build and operate reliable industrial spaces where companies operate with certainty, and people and communities thrive.

 Over 200,000 m2 of industrial buildings built for Heineken México, Caterpillar, Henkel and Polaris, among others; 350,000 m2 of developed industrial sites; and a proprietary portfolio of over 100,000 m2 leased to PepsiCo, Vitro, Nemak and Mission Foods.
